examples.text: The process will take about 14 to 16 months of weekly classes and testing（test的-ing形式）.

examples.text: Just like any other form of media, the quality of this massive collection of information is unequal, and there is good information as well as rubbish.

examples.text: At 15 vehicles per mile per lane, one driver tapping the brakes can cause traffic jams（jam的复数形式）.

examples.text: He took her hand and felt the scar on her thumb, legacy of an accident with a kitchen knife in the early days of their marriage.
